query:
SELECT count(*) AS "count!"
          FROM teams t
         WHERE (NOT $1::boolean OR t.deleteat = 0)
           AND ($2::boolean IS NULL
                OR t.allowopeninvite = $2
                OR ($3::boolean AND EXISTS (
                       SELECT 1 FROM accesscontrolpolicies acp
                        WHERE acp.id = t.id AND acp.type = 'team'
                   )))
